target.name: Pacific Gradient to Lahaina Fire & Blackout

story_scenes.title: Pacific Pressure Gradient Builds
story_scenes.narration: Hurricane Dora tracks south of Hawaii while strong high pressure sits north, setting up a steep wind pressure corridor aimed at Maui.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: MERRA-2 wind + Black Marble establish healthy pre-fire town lights and rising trade gusts.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Coastal harbor water still reflects calmly (-22 dB).

causal_chain.explanation: Compressed pressure lines channel fast easterly winds through Maui mountain passes.

story_scenes.title: 35 m/s Downslope Gale Surge
story_scenes.narration: Air diving down the West Maui leeward slopes dries and accelerates to 35 m/s (126 km/h), desiccating invasive roadside grasses.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Wind speed + surface temperature expose extreme downslope drying and wind-throw risk.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Offshore waves jump +12 dB in radar under extreme gusts.

causal_chain.explanation: Downslope adiabatic warming strips moisture from leeward grasslands.

story_scenes.title: Fire Ignition & Sudden Blackout
story_scenes.narration: Gale-toppled lines ignite dry grass. Black Marble drops by 85% within hours as the grid collapses while embers surge downhill.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Nightlights blackout pinpoints lost neighborhoods simultaneously with thermal heat plumes.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Dense smoke plume hides daytime Sentinel-2 imagery across West Maui.

causal_chain.explanation: Wind-whipped infrastructure sparks and fails ahead of the advancing flame wall.

story_scenes.title: Thermal Peak & SAR Through Smoke
story_scenes.narration: MODIS & ECOSTRESS pierce smoke to register extreme urban fire temperatures while SAR maps structural collapse of buildings.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Thermal radiation isolates active combustion while SAR structural coherence shows rubble vs intact roofs.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Radar Guard filters offshore ocean foam chop so coastal search zones stay accurate.

causal_chain.explanation: Collapsed metal/wooden roofs destroy radar double-bounce corner reflections.

story_scenes.title: Burn Perimeter & Aid Lighting
story_scenes.narration: Flames are contained. Post-fire SAR change maps and emergency camp lights map the recovery perimeter before rebuilding.
story_scenes.why_these_layers: Before-vs-Peak SAR change isolates structural damage cleanly without waiting for clear skies.
story_scenes.illusion_note: Calm trade winds return harbor ocean surfaces to clean specular baseline.

causal_chain.explanation: Comparing pre-fire Aug 06 vs Aug 17 SAR exposes exact damaged blocks.

illusion_summary: 35 m/s offshore winds churn ocean foam near Lahaina harbor mimicking solid ground in radar, while thick smoke blinds daytime optical imagery right as thermal and night-light sensors pinpoint the disaster.
causal_summary: Hurricane Dora Pressure Gradient -> 35 m/s Downslope Foehn Winds -> Grid Line Ignition & -85% Black Marble Outage -> 650 K Thermal Peak Through Smoke -> SAR Building Collapse.

geo_features.label: Hurricane Dora Trade-Wind Accelerator
geo_features.detail: Sub-synoptic pressure gradient south of Hawaii drives extreme offshore trade winds across Maui.

geo_features.label: West Maui Downslope Foehn Jet (35 m/s)
geo_features.detail: Dry katabatic air spills over Pu'u Kukui ridge straight downslope into Lahaina.

geo_features.label: Lahaina Urban Firestorm Footprint
geo_features.detail: Sentinel-1 building corner-reflector drop & thermal plume trace 870 ha of coastal destruction.

geo_features.label: Lahaina Channel Wind-Chop Illusion
geo_features.detail: 35 m/s gusts spike coastal sea backscatter (+12 dB), masking true shoreline boundary.
